## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (new engine mode, generative card, or MCP tool)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization or hardening
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I have executed `bun test` locally and all 14+ unit tests pass.
- [ ] I have executed `bun run build` and confirmed Turbopack compiles without errors.
- [ ] I have added appropriate unit or integration tests for my change.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if introducing new user-facing features.
